sounds._about: WAV files played from the player's Half-Life folder (never shipped).

rows.when: player kills a hostile mob while CS mode is on

vanilla_hidden._about: Minecraft HUD elements skipped while CS mode is on (Fabric HudElementRegistry.replaceElement). health_bar also marks that Minecraft's HUD is showing (hud-toggle check).

flashlight._about: CS 1.6 flashlight (F): a battery of 100 drains 1 per drainSeconds while on and charges 1 per chargeSeconds while off (Half-Life FLASH_DRAIN_TIME 1.2 / FLASH_CHARGE_TIME 0.2). The spot is a Minecraft light block where the beam ends, level 15 up close fading to farLevel at rangeBlocks (CS traces 2048 units, about 51 blocks).

rows.use: seconds per 1% of battery while on
seconds per 1% of battery while off
light level of the spot at the end of the range
Half-Life folder holding cstrike/ and valve/

rows.passes_when: hud.txt parsed and v_knife.mdl loaded from the player's CS copy
the CS knife viewmodel is drawn for 40 frames in a world
Deagle bought at spawn and 50AE ammo bought 300 blocks away, money reduced by exactly their prices
a Deagle shot at a zombie 5 blocks ahead damages it
R refills the Deagle clip from the 50AE reserve (server state)
Deagle shots break an obsidian block 3 blocks ahead after several hits
a bought C4 is planted after holding fire for the 3 s plant
holding use on the planted C4 for 10 s defuses it
F6 shows Minecraft's HUD, F6 again brings the CS HUD back with money and weapons unchanged
in third person the Deagle in hand is synced (CsNet.HELD) and drawn with CS's p_deagle.mdl for 20 frames
the test world is opened to others and a join address is written to melty.log (e4mc relay domain, or the LAN address)
F turns the flashlight on, a light block lights the wall the player looks at, the battery drains, and F again takes the light away

rows.action: switch CS 1.6 / Minecraft interface (see controls.json for the rest)
